about_the_game:
You are a former government operative — weaponized and altered by clandestine experiments — now haunted by the brutal murder of your parents.
In a dystopic city of the 1990s, you chase a single, burning purpose: vengeance.

When an enigmatic assassin syndicate offers you the lead you crave, the price is paid in blood.
They’ll help you hunt the killers behind your family’s massacre — but only if you do their work first.
Accept assassination contracts, cripple rival factions, and extract secrets from the city’s rotten core.
Each contract buys you a sliver of truth; each truth drags you deeper into a conspiracy that twists memory, technology, and power.

To survive, you’ll rely not only on brutal skill and ruthless reflexes, but also on the unnatural powers granted by your augmentations.
Enhanced strength, sharpened senses, and experimental abilities make you faster, deadlier, and more unpredictable than your enemies.

Combat is savage and immediate: lightning-fast strikes, brutal gunplay, and lethal close-quarters improvisation.
You’ll be outnumbered and outgunned; survival demands precision, speed.

As you carve a path through gangs, corporate militias, and corrupt officials, the line between justice and obsession blurs —
and the syndicate’s own motives may be darker than the enemies you dispatch.

A visceral fusion of retro 90s aesthetics, pounding synths, and unforgiving action, this is a descent into a city where favors are paid in corpses...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz (Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD Athlon X2)
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU compatible OpenGL 3.3 (Intel HD Graphics 4000 ou équivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 350 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 (3.0 GHz) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870 / Intel UHD 620 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 350 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: In a dystopian 1990s city, you are a government-made killer turned renegade, hunting your parents’ murderers. Guided by an assassin syndicate, you’ll trade blood for secrets, wield brutal combat and lethal augmentations, and descend into a conspiracy of violence and betrayal.
